title: Campus Canteen Congestion Tracker
description: Design a live queue and wait-time estimator for campus food counters, allowing students to report live surges and find the fastest counter.

title: Peer Book & Equipment Lending Ledger
description: Build an escrow-style lending dashboard for students to borrow lab equipment, calculators, and textbooks with return-due reminders.

title: Campus Food-Waste Redistribution Board
description: Create an alert board connecting hostel mess coordinators with campus volunteer clubs to claim surplus food before it spoils.

title: College Bus Live Route Status & Delay Beacon
description: Develop a commuter assistant showing route stops, estimated arrival times, and student delay check-ins for college transit buses.

title: High-Contrast Screen Reader News Digest
description: Construct an accessible reader for campus announcements featuring keyboard-only navigation, high-contrast themes, and audio read-aloud.

title: Voice-Assisted Emergency Alert Messenger
description: Build a hands-free alert interface that listens for verbal trigger phrases and prepares a pre-structured emergency SOS notice.

title: Dyslexia-Friendly Document Reformatter
description: Create a reading utility that cleans noisy text into weighted dyslexia-friendly typography, adjustable line spacing, and syllable highlighting.

title: Colorblind Data Visualization Palette Checker
description: Design an interactive tool that previews charts under Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia color filters with automated contrast scoring.

title: Distraction-Free Rapid Markdown Note Stream
description: Build a fast keyboard-driven scratchpad that auto-converts markdown, organizes snippets with hashtags, and exports cleanly formatted PDFs or HTML.

title: Micro-Commitment Study Sprint Timer
description: Create a focus timer enforcing 15-minute bursts with friction-based break locks and streak-decay mechanics if abandoned early.

title: Kanban Matrix with Auto-Decay Backlog
description: Construct a dynamic task board where tasks not touched within 48 hours visually fade and auto-archive to prevent priority clutter.

title: Flashcard Generator with Leitner Box Scheduler
description: Develop a revision dashboard that sorts cards into 5 Leitner review boxes based on recall confidence with spaced repetition queues.

title: Neighborhood Hazard & Pothole Reporter
description: Build a community issue board allowing citizens to log road hazards with coordinates, severity tags, and status tracking for local repairs.

title: Emergency Blood Donor Availability Matcher
description: Design an urgent donor registry allowing hospital seekers to filter eligible donors by blood group, locality, and last donation date.

title: E-Waste Recycling Drop-Off Directory
description: Create a drop-point finder guiding users to safe disposal centers for batteries, laptops, and cables with incentive credit calculation.

title: Local Disaster Shelter Capacity Monitor
description: Construct an emergency shelter dashboard tracking occupancy, medical supplies, and flood/storm warning status during severe weather.

title: Ambient Soundscape & Binaural Beat Mixer
description: Build a multi-track audio player synthesizing rain, white noise, and keyboard clicks with volume sliders and sleep timer fadeout.

title: Interactive Breathing & Heart-Rate Pacer
description: Create an immersive visual respiration guide using expanding canvas circles and haptic/audio cues for 4-7-8 anxiety reduction.

title: Procedural Audio Synthesizer & Visualizer
description: Design a browser synthesizer letting users generate melodic frequencies with visual oscilloscope waveforms reacting in real-time.

title: Digital Detox Pledge & Habit Tracker
description: Develop a pledge dashboard that logs offline hours, visualizes digital detox milestones, and awards celebratory badges upon completion.
